label: POST-HOC analysis (not pre-registered) · released-checkpoint result, not a paper reproduction · motion statistics only

regret.note: Conventional regret (optimal expected return minus achieved return) cannot be calculated. The saved design has no optimal-policy reference: (i) the reward supremum 0 (coord_ah^R = tau exactly) is a property of the reward function, not the value of any known or attainable policy; (ii) the best-of-8x8 (0.408) and FG-1 best-of-16 contexts are selection oracles over noise draws that use the outcome, not policies; (iii) per-clip FG-1 fits are a different estimator, clip set and noise set. No optimal reward, success criterion or regret bound is defined here. The statistics in this analysis are baseline-relative (trained minus uncoupled) and must not be read as regret.

formulas.return: R = r_ah - sum_k lambda_k c_k; r_ah = -|coord_ah^R - tau|; single-step episodes, return = reward
